title: Citi Turns Negative on Dollar After Warning on US Buyback Risk

title: Emerging FX Trade Mixed as Treasury’s Buyback Boost Fades

title: Gold Wavers as Yields Rebound, Oil Jump Fuels Inflation Worries
summary: Gold wavered as bond yields rebounded, with the Treasury’s surprise buyback plan seen as a short-term fix, while rising oil prices fueled concern that inflation will prompt the Federal Reserve to raise interest rates.

title: US Set to Cut Tariffs on Canada Metals, Autos in Trade Deal
summary:
The tentative trade deal between the US and Canada would lower tariffs on certain Canadian exports of steel and aluminum to 25% and cut duties on Canadian auto exports to 15%, according to people familiar with the matter.
Tariffs on the non-US content in autos exported from Canada would be reduced to 15% from 25%, and the move on steel and aluminum under discussion would generally halve US tariffs on imports of the two metals. Bloomberg's Derek Decloet joins to discuss. (Source: Bloomberg)

title: India Allows Tax-Free Sugar Import in Rare Move to Cool Prices
summary: India, the world’s second-biggest sugar producer, has allowed mills and refiners to import duty-free raw sugar in an effort to tame record local prices.

title: Bitcoin’s Short Squeeze Leaves Rally Hunting for Real Buyers
summary: Bitcoin extended gains to beyond $72,000 on Thursday after a record squeeze forced bearish traders out of the market, but signs that fresh leveraged longs are replacing them remain limited.

title: Vylor Is Set to Raise $1.1 Billion in Pre-Spinoff Bond Sale

title: Deere Rallies as Machine Orders Raise Farm Recovery Optimism
